screening_summary_default: The screening was negative (no valid Kestrel or adVNTR data).
coverage_not_measured_note: Note: VNTR coverage was not measured for this run, so the coverage quality gate was not evaluated.

coverage_notes.reduced_no_finding: VNTR depth is reduced: mean {mean}x, below {threshold}x. Detection is somewhat less sensitive at this depth.
coverage_notes.low_no_finding: VNTR depth is low: mean {mean}x, below {threshold}x. Detection is unreliable at this depth, so this result does not exclude a variant.
coverage_notes.uncovered: {percent}% of the VNTR region has no read coverage (limit {limit}%). Check the alignment over the region before relying on this result.
coverage_notes.action_no_finding: Re‐sequence the sample or use an orthogonal method (e.g., SNaPshot for dupC, long‐read sequencing for other variants) if a variant is suspected.

length_estimation.label: Approximate total diploid VNTR repeat count
length_estimation.help: Research-only estimate of the total repeat count across both alleles. It does not affect variant calls or screening conclusions.

standard_length_estimation.help: Research-only estimate across both alleles; variant calls and screening conclusions are unchanged.

sources.local-research: Uses a locally fitted development model.

count_conventions.source-reported: Predicts assay-reported repeat counts; inclusion of terminal invariant units is unspecified.
count_conventions.complete: Predicts complete repeat counts including invariant units.
count_conventions.canonical-only: Predicts canonical repeat counts excluding invariant units.

standard_length_estimation.extrapolation_help: Some measurements are outside the model training range; the estimate involves extrapolation.

labels.typical_error: (typical error ≈{error} repeats, leave-one-out RMSE; not an interval)

caution.badge: Above {threshold} repeats: detection sensitivity may be reduced
caution.help: The total VNTR array (both alleles) is estimated above {threshold} repeats. Kestrel's depth-ratio floor makes frameshift detection less sensitive as the array grows, and the estimate tends to under-state very long arrays.

high.badge: Above {threshold} repeats: long array, detection less sensitive
high.help: The total VNTR array (both alleles) is estimated above {threshold} repeats. In simulation, detection in arrays above 150 true repeats was 29 of 32 for dupC and 11 of 23 for other frameshifts, because Kestrel's depth ratio falls as the array grows. The estimate has a typical error of about 14 repeats and tends to under-state very long arrays.
high.notice_not_positive: The VNTR array is estimated at about {estimate} repeats (above {threshold}). Frameshift detection is less sensitive in arrays this long, mostly for variants other than dupC; a result without a finding does not rule one out.
